preiffelstairs.name: Eiffel Tower
preiffelstairs.slogan: Iron lace you can climb one landing at a time.
preiffelstairs.line: My tower will be the tallest edifice ever erected by man.
preiffelstairs.by: Gustave Eiffel, replying to critics, c. 1887

pclouvre.name: Louvre Pyramid
pclouvre.slogan: A glass diamond set in a royal courtyard.
pclouvre.line: I. M. Pei's glass pyramid opened in 1989 and is made of 673 panes, not the 666 of the old legend.

pcnotredame.name: Notre-Dame
pcnotredame.slogan: Eight centuries of stone, back from the flames.
pcnotredame.line: Begun in 1163, the cathedral burned on 15 April 2019 and reopened in December 2024.

pnsacrecoeur.name: Sacré-Cœur
pnsacrecoeur.slogan: White domes above the rooftops of Montmartre.

pwarcdetriomphe.name: Arc de Triomphe
pwarcdetriomphe.slogan: Twelve avenues, one roundabout, one great gate.
pwarcdetriomphe.line: Napoleon ordered it in 1806, but it was only inaugurated in 1836; 284 steps lead to the roof.
